units.source_text: 其间歇息四天，七月十六日在箱根第二次续弈。

en.t: After a four-day break, play resumed for the second session in Hakone on July 16.

units.source_text: 做记录的少女，以前一直身穿藏青底碎白花和服，也换上地道的白色绢麻夏装了。

en.t: The young woman keeping the record, who had always worn a navy-blue kimono with tiny white flowers before, had also changed into a proper white silk-and-linen summer outfit.
